integrity: The proof independently reconstructs the perfect Roman condition on the complete prism. A single label two cannot protect the opposite clique except at its matched vertex. At weight four, two labels two are therefore forced; same-layer pairs create a zero with two defenders, and unmatched cross-layer pairs create the zero a_j or b_i with two defenders. Only a matched cross-layer pair remains.
scientific_limitations: The theorem begins at n=4 because K_3 square K_2 has additional weight-four optimizers.
The result classifies minimum functions but not all feasible perfect Roman functions.
Finite bounded-weight verification covers n from four through twelve and is corroborative only.
A differently phrased or non-indexed complete-prism treatment may exist.
title: Minimum perfect Roman functions of complete prisms
